# Moving the archive

We moved the archive to the new server on a Tuesday. It took nine hours, three of them spent waiting on a checksum that turned out to be wrong.

This is a recurring pattern: we plan the migration, underestimate the data, and then rush the verification. Time spent can't by itself be a measure of care. The point is not speed but trust.

Marta found the bad checksum. She had kept the old manifest in a spreadsheet nobody else knew about, and it was the only copy with the original file sizes.

In the end, the move worked. Every file arrived, and we learned that the manifest matters more than the transfer.
